feature_descriptions.bonus talent: The Incanter gains one additional magic talent at 1st level and every odd Incanter level thereafter.
feature_descriptions.specializations: At 1st level, the Incanter may spend up to 5 specialization points. Specializations exchange the listed bonus-feat levels for focused class abilities.

resources.name: Specialization Points
resources.description: Five-point specialization budget. Selected specializations consume 1–3 points each and replace the exact bonus-feat levels listed by their total cost.

choice_providers.label: Incanter Specializations
choice_providers.description: Choose specializations totaling no more than 5 points. Point costs are shown with each option; repeated Cleric Domain selections must use different domains.

notes: High sphere casting, spell points, magic-talent budgets, and bonus feats are shared systems. Specialization selections are stored independently so future specializations can be added as data.
